summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.03/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.03 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 4, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 14. AAA figures put the statewide average 28¢ lower than a week ago, 1¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.38 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.77) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.38).
